subject: general
question: Which of the following terms is NOT associated with cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Slam dunk**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Slamdunk:

 
 
• A basketball slam dunk occurs when a player jumps in the air and drives the basketball through the hoop while touching the rim with one or two hands. 
 
• A successful dunk is worth two points for the offense team.
 
• The official score of the play is a field goal for that player since it is an attempt to score.
 
 

 
• Terms associated with cricket are:

 
 
• ​Toss, Run, Wicket, Pitch, Crease, Pavilion, Wicket Keeper, Over, Maiden Over, Follow-on, Ashes, Catch, Bowled, Stump Out, Run Out, L.B.W, Hit Wicket, Not out, No ball, Wide ball, Dead ball, Overthrow, Bye, Leg bye, Cover drive.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Terminologies associated with some other sports
